lines.en: Hey, how'd the interview go?
Not good.

and I got fired from Ralph Lauren.

Well, my boss was at the same restaurant
where I was having my interview, and he heard everything.

and he tells me that he's gonna have to let me go
because I'm not a team player.

while he proved that that, in fact, was true.

Oh.
